pathways.name: Water-Ice Thermal Extraction
pathways.description: Heats icy regolith to sublimate water ice; vapour is captured and condensed.

yield_model.note: 72% capture efficiency — losses to sublimation leakage and cold-trap re-deposition

pathways.name: Regolith Oxygen Extraction (Hydrogen Reduction)
pathways.description: Reduces ilmenite (FeTiO3) in regolith using hydrogen; produces water then electrolysed for O2.

energy_constants.source: Leger et al. PNAS — end-to-end LOX from ilmenite-bearing regolith

yield_model.note: Assumes 10 wt% ilmenite in mare regolith (Taylor et al. 2019 XRD data)
